_meta.description: Single source of truth for all pricing used by bench.py --estimate and analyze.py. Never hardcode prices in code.
_meta.rule: Anthropic first-party pricing and Amazon Bedrock pricing are SEPARATE price lists. Never mix them, never assume one from the other.
_meta.cache_semantics: cache_write is the one-time premium for writing a cacheable prefix (5-minute TTL); cache_read is the discounted rate for tokens served from cache. Tokens reported in input_tokens exclude cache read/write tokens on both providers - verify against your first real invoice line items.

anthropic.source: Anthropic first-party price list (platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing), as cached 2026-06-24. Verify at https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing before quoting numbers externally.

bedrock.source: AWS Price List API (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, offer AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, us-east-1), pulled 2026-07-25. Values are the REGIONAL (geo, us.* inference profile) on-demand tier - the tier bench.py's us.anthropic.* model IDs bill against. NOTE: Bedrock GLOBAL-routing tier prices are exactly Anthropic first-party parity; the regional tier carries a uniform 10% premium. Cache-write values are the 5-minute-TTL tier (1h tier priced separately, not used).
